download_document_file.description: Download a PDF bitstream previously discovered on the requested NPLG item page. Arbitrary URLs are not accepted.
download_document_file.name: download_document_file
download_document_file.title: Download a public PDF

get_document_metadata.description: Read rich Dublin Core metadata for an NPLG item, preferring OAI-DIM and falling back to the full XMLUI/Manakin record.
get_document_metadata.name: get_document_metadata
get_document_metadata.title: Read full document metadata

get_render_manifest.description: Read deterministic page-render metadata and signed image URLs for an existing render identifier.
get_render_manifest.name: get_render_manifest
get_render_manifest.title: Read a render manifest

inspect_pdf.description: Classify every PDF page and report embedded scan dimensions, effective DPI, crop, rotation, and text-overlay characteristics.
inspect_pdf.name: inspect_pdf
inspect_pdf.title: Inspect a downloaded PDF

list_document_files.description: List public or restricted bitstreams bound to a canonical NPLG item handle.
list_document_files.name: list_document_files
list_document_files.title: List document files

render_pdf_page_tiles.description: Crop a rendered page into overlapping JPEG tiles without resizing. Defaults are 2048×2048 with 128-pixel overlap.
render_pdf_page_tiles.name: render_pdf_page_tiles
render_pdf_page_tiles.title: Create crop-only page tiles

render_pdf_pages.description: Render selected pages on their native embedded-scan pixel grid when determinable; otherwise use an explicitly labelled 400-DPI fallback.
render_pdf_pages.name: render_pdf_pages
render_pdf_pages.title: Render PDF pages as JPEG

search_documents.description: Search the NPLG DSpace repository, optionally within a canonical collection handle, and return an opaque continuation cursor.
search_documents.name: search_documents
search_documents.title: Search NPLG Iverieli
